name: Crossroads
summary: At Crossroads, Horde travelers meet where the Gold Road crosses the route from Ratchet to the Stonetalon Mountains. The outpost handles trade, military staging, and travel between Durotar, Mulgore, and the northern frontlines.

sections.title: A Vital Junction in the Savannah
sections.body: Crossroads sits where the Gold Road meets the route from the goblin port of Ratchet into the Stonetalon Mountains. Its lodgings are modest, but travelers find wind rider masters, merchants, blacksmiths, and trainers beneath the watchtowers. For young warriors from Durotar or Mulgore, the outpost reveals how the new Horde links its far-flung fronts and supplies.

sections.title: Frontier Outpost Under Siege
sections.body: Keeping order at Crossroads is a constant struggle. Plains raptors prowl close enough to steal payroll silver from the guard towers, while harpies, quilboar, and centaur tribes press against the perimeter. Neutral Ratchet lies nearby, and Ashenvale's contested forests are within reach. Alliance scouts often strike near the outpost's defensive barricades.

faq.q: Why is the Crossroads so important to the Horde?
faq.answer: Crossroads anchors central Kalimdor's main routes. Travelers moving overland between Durotar, Mulgore, Ratchet, Stonetalon, or Ashenvale pass through or near the outpost, making it a key point for supplies and reinforcements.

faq.q: Who provides flight transport at the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Devrak manages the wind rider roost at Crossroads. He connects travelers to outposts across Kalimdor, including Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance attack the Crossroads so frequently?
faq.answer: Crossroads lies at the heart of Horde travel, within striking distance of Ashenvale and Ratchet. Alliance raiding parties target the outpost to disrupt Horde supply lines.

faq.q: What happened to the outpost's payroll silver?
faq.answer: Barrens raptors stole a shipment of silver from the Crossroads guard tower. The silver was meant to pay the defending guards, and the raptors scattered it across the surrounding savannah.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you find Crossroads linking the homelands of orcs, tauren, and trolls while coordinating supplies across Kalimdor. It is a proving ground for your fledgling nation.
As an Alliance member, you can strike Crossroads to disrupt Horde reinforcements moving between Orgrimmar, Mulgore, and Ashenvale's disputed borders.
